subject.summary: Original cream-lacquer 2017 Ref. 5320G-001. Photo-measured 40 mm stepped-lug case, twin calendar windows, syringe hands, scalloped moon/date register and sapphire-back calibre 324 S Q. All outlines and internal arrangements are inferred, not factory CAD. Moon motion is time-compressed; strap ends are cropped.
